svg.title: Multi-repo Synapse CI/CD architecture
svg.desc: Three repositories with cross-repo workflow dispatch for environment promotion: dev deploys and tags, then dispatches to test, which dispatches to prod.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Synapse Studio connect to the dev repo?')
sendPrompt('Describe the dev repo collaboration branch workflow')
sendPrompt('How does the dev Terraform apply work?')
sendPrompt('How does the dev Synapse deployment and tagging work?')
sendPrompt('How does the test Terraform apply work?')
sendPrompt('How does the test Synapse deployment receive artifacts from dev?')
sendPrompt('How does the prod Terraform apply work?')
sendPrompt('How does the prod Synapse deployment and tagging work?')
sendPrompt('What is the dev workspace configuration?')
sendPrompt('What is the test workspace configuration?')
sendPrompt('What is the prod workspace configuration?')
